definitions: Firm belief in the reliability, truth, ability, or strength of someone or something.
Acceptance of the truth of a statement without evidence or investigation.
An arrangement whereby a person (a trustee) holds property as its nominal owner for the good of one or more beneficiaries.
A large company or group of companies that has a monopoly or near-monopoly on the supply of a product or service.
examples: I put my trust in you.
The money was held in a trust.
The government moved to break up the trust.
